items.originalEnglish: I feel like I belong at this school.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得自己属于这所学校。

items.originalEnglish: I can really be myself at this school.
items.workingChinese: 在这所学校，我能够真正做自己。

items.originalEnglish: I am good at helping students learn new things.
items.workingChinese: 我善于帮助学生学习新的东西。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like people at this school care about me.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得这所学校的人关心我。

items.originalEnglish: I have accomplished a lot as a teacher.
items.workingChinese: 作为教师，我已经取得了不少成就。

items.originalEnglish: I am treated with respect at this school.
items.workingChinese: 在这所学校，我受到尊重。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like my teaching is effective and helpful.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得自己的教学是有效而且有帮助的。

administration.instructionsEnglish: Below are some questions about your experiences as a teacher. Read each sentence and choose the one response that best describes how you felt in the past month.
administration.instructionsZh: 下面是一些关于你作为教师的经历的问题。请阅读每句话，选择最能描述你在过去一个月中感受的选项。

presentationChanges: 保留原题顺序和逐题响应集。
指导语移入第一题之前，是明确记录的数字呈现调整，不声称原验证版式。
